meta.name: financial-modeling
meta.description: Builds and stress-tests financial models for forecasting, scenario planning, and decision support — revenue build, cost structure, driver logic, and the sensitivities that show where a plan breaks. Use this to model a decision's financial consequence, build a forecast or long-range plan, evaluate an investment or hire, or pressure-test someone else's model before relying on it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 建立并压力测试财务模型，预测经营结果并找出计划脆弱点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做决策前需要先算清财务后果。
copy.tagline_en: Build and stress-test financial models to see where your plan breaks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to weigh the financial consequences of a decision before committing.

howto.what: Claude 会构建和检验财务模型：区分输入、计算、输出三层，用驱动因素（如销量×价格）建收入，做敏感性分析，并检查硬编码与行一致性。
howto.when: 当用户要求构建财务预测、评估投资或招聘、或压力测试他人模型时触发。

say.text: 帮我为下季度收入建一个驱动因素模型。
say.note: Claude 会按量价等驱动构建输入、计算、输出三层。

say.text: 审查这份财务模型，找出硬编码并检查行一致性。
say.note: 会追踪数字、找常量，测试极端值。

say.text: 对这个计划做敏感性分析，看哪些假设影响最大。
say.note: 会找出关键假设并计算盈亏平衡。

howto.what_en: Claude builds and stress-tests financial models: inputs/calculations/outputs layers, driver-based revenue (volume×price), sensitivity analysis, and review for hard-coded constants and row consistency.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to model financial consequences, build a forecast, evaluate an investment or hire, or pressure-test an existing model.

say_en.text: Help me build a driver-based revenue model for next quarter.
say_en.note: Claude will structure it into inputs, calculations, outputs.

say_en.text: Review this financial model, find hard-coded numbers and check row consistency.
say_en.note: It will trace numbers, find constants, and test extremes.

say_en.text: Run a sensitivity analysis on this plan to see which assumptions matter most.
say_en.note: It will identify key drivers and breakeven points.
